# Bill of materials - Phase 1 - MC-1 monocopter

Masses are catalogue values and prices are indicative USD (hobby market, vary by region and supplier). The printed-parts mass comes from the CAD files. Weigh each part as you build and update this file; the sizing page and the docs are generated from it.

|---|---|
| **825 g** | **$439** |

Interactive version with live mass budget: [web/bom.html?model=monocopter](../../web/bom.html?model=monocopter). CSV: [monocopter.csv](../../hardware/bom/monocopter.csv).

## Propulsion

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| P-01 | Brushless motor 2810, about 1100 KV | 1 | 56 | 28 | yes | 28xx outrunner, 4S rated 40 A, M3 mount 16 x 16 or 19 x 19 mm, Ø5 mm shaft - Mounted upside down under the hub plate, shaft down. Static thrust is measured on the thrust stand at Gate 1. |
| P-02 | Propeller 10 x 4.5 two-blade, pusher type (mounted) | 1 | 12 | 6 | yes | 10 inch (254 mm), reverse-pitch (pusher) for the rotation direction of the motor - The prop hangs below the motor and blows air down through the vanes: it must be a pusher type. |
| P-03 | Spare propellers 10 x 4.5 pusher | 2 | 12 | 6 | no | Same rotation as the mounted prop - Balance every prop before use. |
| P-04 | ESC 40 A, 4S, BLHeli_S / AM32, PWM 400 Hz | 1 | 15 | 22 | yes | Single ESC, standard 1000 to 2000 us signal - Mounted on the electronics deck in the intake airflow. |

## Power

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| E-01 | LiPo 4S 1500 mAh, 75C+, XT60 | 1 | 175 | 28 | yes | 14.8 V nominal, about 75 x 35 x 34 mm - Check size: it must fit 75 x 35 x 35 mm between the strap slots. |
| E-02 | Servo BEC 6.0 V / 5 A | 1 | 9 | 8 | yes | Switching regulator, 4S input - Powers the four servos only. Never from the ESC. |
| E-03 | Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A | 1 | 6 | 5 | yes | Switching regulator, 4S input - Powers the ESP32 board and the receiver. |
| E-04 | Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone | 1 | 14 | 4 | yes |  |
| E-05 | Arming switch + remove-before-flight loop | 1 | 8 | 5 | yes | Switch in the battery lead or on the deck - Remove the loop to cut the battery lead before any work near the prop. |
| E-06 | Battery voltage divider 47 k / 10 k + 100 nF | 1 | 1 | 1 | yes | Divides the pack voltage to 3 V at full charge for the ESP32 ADC - Check with a multimeter before connecting the ADC pin. |
